profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, C#, Spark
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and cloud-based solutions at Microsoft and Amazon. Skilled in C#, Python (PySpark), Java, and JavaScript, with a strong focus on data platforms, CI/CD, and distributed systems. Proven track record of owning projects end-to-end, collaborating across teams, and delivering reliable, high-performance software. Now seeking impactful roles to drive innovation and growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scanning (2021-2022)
- Working on improving scanning tool enabling customers to analyze data sources for sensitive information.
- Designed and implemented algorithms for efficient data scanning and classification to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate the scanning tool into existing software ecosystems.

Purview Insights (2022-2024)
- Contributed to the backend development of Purview Insights, a product providing detailed reports on data classifications and sensitivity labels.
- Developed Python code for report aggregation, enhancing the platform's capability to deliver actionable insights to customers.
- Ensured the scalability and performance of backend systems to accommodate large datasets and diverse customer needs.

Platform for Job Service (Current)
- In charge of setting up the infrastructure for this project
- Currently leading the creation of a centralized platform within the Security organization.
- Designing and implementing a platform for partner teams to submit Spark jobs and retrieve results efficiently.
- Collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Software Design and +10 skills
